svg.title: Pundoku wordmark — D3 «Капля»
svg.desc: Drawn letterforms, not a font: monolinear geometric construction, stroke 22 on a cap height of 104 and an x-height of 76. No glyph from any typeface is embedded, so there is no font licence to clear. The right stem of the n in "Pun" ends in a hanging drop (r=17 at the stem axis, 34 wide against a 22 stem) — the one letterform intervention, and it sits on the last letter of the player's name.
